correctness.rationale: The quadratic Gauss sum gives exact Gram entries with conditional normalization. The Hamming-radius-two Johnson harmonic decomposition and matching swap yield all eigenvalue multiplicities, checked to sum to the full band dimension. An elementary polynomial-vanishing argument proves rank in every dimension. Exact Sylvester minors and a polynomial-division sign prove the sharp extremal modes. Standalone independent enumeration confirms 5,110 exact entries and 126 spectral values for four parameter choices; finite computations are not used to infer the general result.
